sections.name: FloatingActionButton
sections.title: Floating create button
sections.what: Draws a large rounded plus button fixed to the bottom-right of the screen. Clicking it opens the quick add window, which is always present but only visible when opened.
sections.why: Likely reason: a fixed corner button keeps the create action available on every page.
sections.watch_out: Because it sits on top of the page, it can cover content or other controls near the bottom-right corner.

summary: A round plus button fixed in the bottom-right corner that opens the quick add window.
purpose: Give the user a create action that is always within reach.
why: Likely reason: a fixed corner button is a common way to offer a create action from any screen.
how: 1. Keeps a flag for whether the quick add window is open. 2. Draws the fixed button. 3. A click sets the flag to open. 4. The quick add window is always rendered and shows only when open.
inputs: Clicks only. The component takes no settings.
risks: Its fixed position can cover content or other buttons in the bottom-right corner, especially on small screens.
debug: If the button does nothing, check the open flag and that the quick add window is rendered. If it covers content, check the fixed position and z-index.
